Hi Jasmine —

Apologies for the delay and thanks for checking in. We did a quick triage this morning and InfoSec has one clarifying blocker before they can greenlight a demo rollout: they need confirmation on two items in the evidence bundle. I've attached a short doc with inline questions (brighttech-soc2-questions.docx). Key points:

1) Logs & PII: Does Redwood ever write user-level PII into application logs that are retained longer than 30 days? If so, what controls are in place?
2) Retention policy: The packet references "log retention configurable by customer" — can you confirm default retention and options for automatic purging at the customer level?

Can Ben or someone on the security team reply with short answers to the two bullets by EOD Friday 7/09? That would let us schedule the Q&A the following week. If you prefer to take these offline in a call, we can book a 30-min slot — otherwise written answers are fine.
